contexts.text: Jacob cooked pottage () = a heap of doctrinal things. Explained.
In the Original it is he pottaged pottage; that is, he heaped it together.
When pottage or pulse is read of, the Angels perceive... doctrinal things not yet conjoined with good, thus an inordinated heap of them.
That pottage or pulse = a heap. Illustrated.
Pottage () = a heap made up of scientifics ill-compacted.

Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils () = the good of life gifted with the good of truth and the good of doctrinals... Pottage of lentils = the good of doctrinals; for pottage or pulse = a heap of doctrinals; and lentils, their good.
Pottage () = the good of the external rituals of the Jewish Church. ( = a heap of doctrinals, such as was that of the Jews. AC 10105:3.)
Of diverse evils makes one pottage. CL 453.
The doctrine of his faith may be compared to pottage made of chaff.
In the brain, which appears like pulp.
In the brain, where they are like pulp.
The pottage, into which they put the bitter gourds, () = the Word falsified; and the meal with which it was healed = truth from good...
